The '''General Ministry Cabinet''' was the governing council of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic General Ministry|General Ministry]]. It consisted of the heads of the various ministries that were a part of the General Ministry. Led by the [[First Administrator]], the Cabinet would report to the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] and carry out their instructions to their respective ministries.
